div.div:
Two domain gates, one project match
Step 1: Firebase rejects a page domain missing from Authorized domains.
Step 3: Core rejects an origin missing from CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS (403).
Step 5: Core returns 401 when the token comes from another Firebase project.
